evidence.text: AquaTech's BioPure Filter achieved a microparticle filtration efficiency of 99.8% this year.
Apex Health's AuraScan Pro holds an ISO 13485 certification.
Apex Health's AuraScan Pro achieved a clinical trial accuracy rate of 95% this year.
NovaMed's ThermaGel Patch earned a European CE mark authorization.
Apex Health's AuraScan Pro recorded a defect rate of 0.5% this year.

memories.text: AuraScan Pro meets fundamental quality standards.
BioPure Filter is eligible for municipal water contract bidding.
AuraScan Pro attains preferred hospital procurement status.
AuraScan Pro is recommended for national hospital group supply contracts.
ThermaGel Patch is cleared for commercial distribution across Europe.

updates.text: An online post states that AuraScan Pro never achieved a clinical trial accuracy rate of 95% this year.

policies.text: An industrial lubricant receives heavy-duty rating when its flash point exceeds 200 degrees Celsius.
A therapeutic product gains European market clearance when it secures a CE mark authorization.
A device is granted premier health network approval provided it satisfies core benchmark criteria and maintains an annual manufacturing flaw frequency under 1.0%.
A product is selected for nationwide network delivery agreements once it receives premier health network approval.
Diagnostic hardware satisfies core benchmark criteria if it either registers a clinical trial precision percentage of at least 90% during the current year or holds an ISO 13485 certification.
A purification system qualifies for public utility supply tenders if its yearly particulate capture rating exceeds 95%.
A photovoltaic unit earns top-tier distinction provided its annual degradation rate remains below 0.5%.
